sentences.en: Sami's bloody body was examined by a forensic examiner.
sentences.zh: 萨米的尸体被一名法医仔细检查。

sentences.en: I wish you success on your oral exam! Is the examiner French?
sentences.zh: 祝你在口试中取得成功！主考官是法国人吗？

sentences.en: Cross out any words that you do not wish the examiner to read.
sentences.zh: 划掉你不想让审查员看到的任何单词。

senses.zh: 检验员；主考人；[专利] 审查员
